title: τ(M, θ, ξ) has the measure representation (Hᵏ⌞M, θξ)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k] on ℝ^P = Eucl P, and let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set. Let M ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) (k-vectors, NVector (Eucl P) k) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ, and let X ∈ D_k(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U k) satisfy X(ω) = τ(M, θ, ξ)(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHᵏ(x) (tauAction k M θ ξ ω) for every test form ω ∈ D^k(U) (TestFormOn U k). Then (Hᵏ⌞M, θξ) is a measure representation of X, i.e. IsMeasureRepresentation X (μHE[k].restrict M) (x ↦ θ(x) • ξ(x)): for every ω ∈ D^k(U) the function x ↦ (θ(x) • ξ(x))(ω(x)) is Hᵏ⌞M-integrable and X(ω) = ∫ (θ(x) • ξ(x))(ω(x)) d(Hᵏ⌞M)(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, X ω = tauAction k M θ ξ ω) → IsMeasureRepresentation X ((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) (fun x => θ x • ξ x)
